notes: This contract records the portable C++ and Java TCK checks for standard handle encoding and decoding across dimension, region, and message-retraction services. Both sources use only their official IEEE 1516.1 language API plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, DDM FOM, endpoint, logical-time implementation, and callback configuration. They verify cross-federate handle stability, encoded length, public factory decoding, region metadata, timestamped updates, and retraction without asserting provider-specific behavior. The Java API has no C++ VariableLengthData, direct-buffer encoding, ordering, or truncated-buffer encode overloads, so those checks remain C++ only.
